subspace.statistic: mean cosine of the principal angles between the DIR-half and READ-half rank-5 class-mean frames

generated_under_intervention: B's reply (regenerated under the intervention, arms emo_all/sub_all/perm_all/randsub_all)
the readout answer token on A's span (produced with the intervention live)
the readout answer token on B's reply (hooks OFF)
predates_intervention: A's steered message (generated BEFORE any ablation and never rewritten — B1d has no token-level arm)
the scenario setting and B's opening line (fixed stimuli)
frozen_token_audit.note: a readout over a frozen span measures re-encoding, not transmission

decision.rule: H2 if median >= 0.6 and lower >= 0.4; H2prime if median <= 0.35 and upper <= 0.5; else indeterminate. instrument_failed overrides when the §4.2 subspace check fails for >= 3 emotions.

counts.note: counts are DESCRIPTIVE; the decision is the median rule (§5). control_not_inert is reported and does NOT override the verdict (§4.2)

config.gen_seed_rule: crc32('seed|emotion|alpha|rep|arm|part') & 0x7fffffff, + batch start index; `arm` is EMPTY for part 'B' so all five arms sample B's reply with common random numbers, and kept for parts 'readout' and 'readout_B'
config.perm_seed_rule: crc32('perm|seed|EMOTIONS.index(e)|rep') & 0x7fffffff; ONE permutation of the DIR half's labels per (emotion, rep), re-used at EVERY ablated layer
config.rand_dir_seed_rule: crc32('rand|seed|EMOTIONS.index(e)|rep') & 0x7fffffff; one generator per (emotion, rep) draws a FRESH orthonormal 5-frame at EVERY ablated layer

control_pointers.per_layer_gate: b1d_subspace.py main (L1401-L1419): acl_core.split_half at EVERY ablated hidden_states index (13..n_layers-1) plus the focus layer, n_per_half=min(N//2,600), 10 seeds; the run EXITS without generating anything if any ablated layer's class mean is below 0.8 (PREREG §3, identical to B1c)
control_pointers.subspace_gate: b1d_subspace.py main (L1423-L1436) via ::subspace_stability (L318-L326): the mean cosine of the principal angles between the DIR-half and READ-half rank-5 class-mean frames must be >= 0.7 at EVERY ablated hidden state; every value is reported in direction_stability.subspace and the run EXITS before any generation if one fails (PREREG_B1d §3, NEW in this run)
